audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4..6].side read 'Pantheon' while content win[4..6] and packet.levelChart both read Azir. Three rows disagreed across layers, and the full-layer .why text under them already described Azir winning.
audit.why: Content and packet agree, and the .why prose was already written from Azir's side ('Nashor's spike: your soldier poke becomes shred', 'Full build Azir is a teamfight'), so the side token was the stale half. Kit backs it: Pantheon's longest reach in lane is a 575 spear against a 740 soldier, and Grand Starfall is 180s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: phases[4..6].side -> Azir; phases[4].why regrounded on Grand Starfall's 180s so the row is not just a template.

audit.why: His spikes are the level 3 full combo and level 6 Grand Starfall (180/165/150s, 5500 range) as map pressure, not lane pressure. Azir's are Nashor's Tooth and Emperor's Divide (120/105/90s).
audit.corrected: breakdown.spikes now names Grand Starfall's range and phases[4].why its cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: The matchup never stated the single most useful interaction in it: Aegis Assault makes Pantheon invulnerable to damage FROM THE FRONT only, and it is a channel.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Pantheon sets his shield, becoming invulnerable to damage from the front and striking repeatedly with his spear', and the kit marks it channel/interruptible. That means (a) soldier damage arriving from behind or the side is not blocked by the shield's arc, and (b) Emperor's Divide's knock-back cuts the channel short. Second: Shield Vault carries an auto-attack reset (kit flag + brief.missingInteractions), so his auto wind-up is the tell, not the cast. Third, the plain range fact the page never used: Comet Spear is 575 and a Sand Soldier reaches 740.
audit.corrected: Front-only shield written into tldr, breakdown.carry, breakdown.late, dosFull[2].d, report[5].t and phases[3].why; auto-reset tell into dosFull[0].d and tradeBad; the range gap into tradeGood, breakdown.early and phases[0].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: content wants.foe[0] read 'Land Comet Spear stun into a full combo kill'. Comet Spear does not stun.
audit.why: Per the kit, Comet Spear thrusts or throws the spear; the stun is Shield Vault (W).
audit.corrected: wants.foe[0] -> 'Land Shield Vault stun into a full combo kill'.

audit.whatIsWrong: COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT on breakdown.cooldowns, and dosFull[2].d invented a 'fifteen-second invitation'.
audit.why: Shield Vault is 13/12/11/10/9 — never fifteen. Comet Spear 11/10.25/9.5/8.75/8, Aegis Assault 22/21/20/19/18, Grand Starfall 180/165/150, Shifting Sands 22/20.5/19/17.5/16.
audit.corrected: Real numbers now in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d; the fabricated fifteen seconds removed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two COPY_PASTE_BLEED bullets: dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim under 'Hold E strictly as the disengage', dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim under 'Waste the wall on a half-committed engage'.
audit.why: Both bodies contradicted their own titles.
audit.corrected: Replaced with bodies that answer their titles — the Shifting Sands vs Shield Vault cooldown maths, and the cost of spending a 120-second wall on a feint.
